reviews.body: I’m pretty picky about what I use on my face, but this has become my go-to and part of my daily routine. It feels great after shaving, moisturizes well, not greasy, and doesn’t leave my skin feeling heavy- its very light! I also tend to have some redness, and I’ve noticed my face looks calmer and more even since I started using it. Really happy with it.
Bought this product for my husband and he absolutely LOOOOOVES it!!! Finally a product that doesn’t scare him away from maintaining great skin.
Really good feel, just too small size. Went through it faster than 6 weeks adverties
Found this on IG and was blown away by how nice it feels and how great my skin looks now. Girlfriend loves it too
Wifey got me this and i'm loving it
Great product.  I don’t usually like having things on my skin, so am skeptical of moisturizers.  But this one rubs in and doesn’t even feel like it’s there.  Highly recommend
So smooth going on, no grease or shine. Love that its helping with my wrinkles too
